hooks.command: sh -c ': fairbay-managed:entry-gate; R="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; S="$R/.claude/skills/session-start/scripts/session_handoff.py"; if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Entry and capture gates did not run: python3 not found."; elif [ ! -f "$S" ]; then echo "Entry gate did not run: $S missing (skills not synced?)."; else python3 "$S" inject || echo "Entry gate failed (exit $?)."; fi; exit 0'

sh -c ': fairbay-managed:capture; R="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; S="$R/.claude/skills/chat-archive/scripts/capture_corrections.py"; [ -f "$S" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 "$S" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0'

sh -c ': fairbay-managed:lane-gate; R="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; S="$R/.claude/skills/session-start/scripts/session_handoff.py"; grep -q "^lanes:" "$R/.claude/landing.yaml" 2>/dev/null && [ -f "$S" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 "$S" lane; exit 0'
